recognize_zh: 中央一群中性球的細胞質內含粗大深紫色團塊（被吞噬的裂殖子或寄生蟲殘骸），周圍大量正常大小紅血球內有細小環狀體，常見一顆紅血球含多個環、雙染色質點與貼邊型，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Cluster of neutrophils containing coarse dark purple cytoplasmic clumps, consistent with phagocytosed merozoites or parasite remnants
Neutrophil nuclei partly obscured by the inclusions; some cells appear degenerating
Heavy parasitemia with small delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes
Multiple rings per red cell, double chromatin dots and appliqué forms
No schizonts or gametocytes in this field; a few spherocytic or polychromatic red cells present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of neutrophils whose cytoplasm contains coarse, dark purple clumped material consistent with phagocytosed merozoites or parasite remnants. The background shows heavy parasitemia with numerous small, delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes, frequently multiple per cell, with double chromatin dots and appliqué forms. No schizonts or gametocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with high parasitemia and neutrophil phagocytosis of parasite material.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, evenly distributed azurophilic granules, not the coarse clumped dark masses seen here in a malaria background.
Vivax infects enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and shows ameboid trophozoites and schizonts, rather than many small multiply infected normal-sized cells.
Babesia also causes multiple rings per cell but produces tetrads and extracellular forms without hemozoin pigment or neutrophil pigment.
Bacteria appear as uniform cocci or rods, whereas these inclusions are irregular clumps accompanying intraerythrocytic rings.
